en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, and Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Sama’at, altogether from Safwan, from Saeed Al Araby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about two men who fell upon a slave girl during one pure period, for whom would the child come to be?’
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the one in whose presence it is, due to the words of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>: ‘The child is for the bed (it is conceived upon), and for the adulterer are the stones’.
